newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 55,500 MT were three and two-fifths times the week earlier and 30 percent above the 4-week average.

The major buyer was Japan (23,500 MT), followed by Turkey (7,500 MT, which includes new sales of 20,000 MT--all rough--and cancellations of 12,500 MT), Mexico (6,300 MT, of which 6,000 MT was rough), Trinidad (5,000 MT), Ghana (4,000 MT), the Netherlands (3,700 MT), Canada (2,900 MT), and El Salvador (2,500 MT--all rough, switched from Guatemala.
Exports of 20,500 MT were down 62 percent from the previous week and the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (10,000 MT) and Mexico (6,300 MT).
